title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・両雄振るわず

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: They're charging up the second slope and around the third corner! It's rough going, but here's where the race really starts!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant… Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, huff… Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Come on, Diamond!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Goooo, Kitasaaan!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black and Satono Diamond! First place has eluded both of today's top racers!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Wow… What a mind-blowing race… Everyone looks exhausted…

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Oh man, I have goosebumps! That was insane!

text_block_list.name: Man in Hoodie
text_block_list.text: Neither of the strongest competitors won, but it was still a great race! Everyone was incredible!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Ahaha! What a race!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: What a fierce clash! They really went all out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I could feel the intensity of the race simply from watching

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Too bad neither of them won… But after seeing a race like this… You know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe… My legs are already tingling with anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: C'mon, let's go find them!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… My legs… They're shaking…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… Mine too…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's so frustrating… I gave it everything I had…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I worked so hard to surpass my limits. But I still couldn't win…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah… I'm so bummed…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: But still… I was able to go beyond my limits today… And it's because I had you pushing me on.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: If I keep running with you, I'm sure I'll become an even greater runner!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I feel the same! It's like I just keep getting more and more power when I run with you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Let's keep competing and make our way to the top together!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! To the top, huh?! You say that like it's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Do you realize who's waiting for you at the top?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: T-Teio?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I reign here at the top! If you want up here, you're gonna have to go through me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, Teio. Don't play it up too much.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Uh… Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Consider this an official challenge from the both of us! McQueen and I will be running in the fall!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You wanna get to the top, right? Then, give us your best shot!

text_block_list.name: Dia & Kitasan
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: A-are you really going to run?! I-I hadn't heard anything about that…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That's correct. We weren't originally planning on running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: However, we have both changed our minds after observing your race today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: We want to race against the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The way you ran today lit a fire in our hearts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What do you say? Do you accept our challenge?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Of course! I would be honored to race with both of you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Me too! I gladly accept!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: That's what I like to hear!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'll be running in the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: And I will be running in the autumn Tenno Sho. I expect to see you both there.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: This is gonna be great! It's been too long since I ran in the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now, if you'll excuse us.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Am I dreaming, Dia? Pinch me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You're not dreaming! That is, unless we're both having the same dream…
choice_data_list: I heard it too. You're not dreaming.
I heard it too. You're not dreaming.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Omigooosh! This is really happening! We get to run against Teio!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And McQueen too! In the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy… To think this day would come…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond trembles with passion and her eyes well up with tears. Kitasan Black reacts much the same.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's hardly surprising. They both entered Tracen Academy because they looked up to Mejiro McQueen and Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna run in both the autumn Tenno Sho and the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I was planning on doing the Senior Autumn Triple Crown tour anyway. What about you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I want to run in the autumn Tenno Sho! I'd like to run against McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That means she'd be running after summer camp. That might make training difficult, considering she doesn't do well in the heat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm a little worried about making the autumn Tenno Sho her first race after summer. It might be wise to run another race first to see how well she's holding up.
choice_data_list: Let's do the Kyoto Daishoten first.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I have no objections. We can refine my training based on my performance there.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: If the fans choose me for the Takarazuka Kinen, I'll run there first, and then the autumn Tenno Sho after!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Let's both do our best to beat McQueen in the autumn Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wow… I still feel like I'm dreaming…
choice_data_list: Reality will sink in soon enough.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, but I can't just sit on cloud nine. This is my chance to compete against McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Both McQueen and Teio are already doing great work as illustrious racers.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I want to learn from them and figure out what being illustrious truly means for me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Especially McQueen. She bears the weight of the Mejiro name, so her circumstances are quite similar to mine.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: As a representative of the Satono family, I must consider what kind of illustrious runner I wish to be.
choice_data_list: I'm always here if you want to talk about it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I promised to realize her dream of becoming an illustrious runner capable of winning G1 races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As a trainer, there's only so much I can do about her future, but I want to help her as much as I can.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm counting on you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Once I beat McQueen…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "The Satono family's dream will finally come true." I finish the sentence for her in my mind, feeling the weight and significance behind each word.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she can beat someone as distinguished as Mejiro McQueen, then she can definitely call herself an illustrious Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But before that, we have the Kyoto Daishoten. We can't afford any setbacks in this warm-up race.
